title: Record effectiveness
purpose: Record whether a nonconformance's actions worked, once the record is in Verification.
summary: Record whether the actions on a nonconformance worked, once it is in Verification. Effective or No corrective action needed lets a supervisor close it.

tasks.title: Record the effectiveness check
steps: Choose the [[Result]], describe [[What was checked]] and select [[Record effectiveness]].

tasks.title: When the actions did not work
steps: Choose [[Not effective]] and describe what was checked.
Then add actions on the record, or move it back with [[Change status]].

good_to_know: Only a record in Verification can be checked. Leaving Verification later clears the check; the history keeps it.
Effective is refused while any action is still open. Mark them done or cancel them first.
Not effective keeps the record open: add actions or move it back.
A new check replaces the one shown on the record.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Opens from Record effectiveness on the record, as a dialog or a full page. Only the owner or a supervisor (the admin role included) may open it; anyone else is refused. While the optional nonconformance module is off it answers Not found.

sections.title: Fields and actions
paragraphs: The form opens with the note Effective needs every action done or cancelled. Not effective keeps the record open: add actions or move it back.

items.label: Result
items.description: Required: Effective, Not effective, or No corrective action needed. Effective and No corrective action needed allow a supervisor to close the record; Not effective does not.

items.label: What was checked
items.description: Required, up to 4,000 characters. What was checked and what it showed.

items.label: Record effectiveness
items.description: Saves, records you and the time as Checked, and confirms Effectiveness check recorded. The history records Effectiveness check recorded with the result before and after.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the record without changing anything.

items.label: Verification only
items.description: Outside Verification saving is refused: Move it to Verification before checking effectiveness.

items.label: Open actions
items.description: Effective while an action is open is refused: Finish or cancel the open actions before recording them effective. No corrective action needed and Not effective are accepted, but closing still needs every action done or cancelled.

items.label: Cleared later
items.description: Moving the record out of Verification, or reopening it after closing, clears the result, the note and who checked it. The history keeps the earlier check.

items.label: Refusals
items.description: A closed record: A closed nonconformance does not change. A supervisor can reopen it. A stale form: This nonconformance changed after you opened it. Reload it and review the latest details. Your input is kept.
